title: Soft-Boiled Eggs
description: Eggs boiled in vinegared water for 7 minutes and shocked in ice, so the white is just set and the golden yolk stays runny. Finished with a pinch of salt or a drizzle of soy sauce.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.line: Salt or soy sauce, to serve

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the vinegar.
Add the eggs and boil for 7 minutes for a runny yolk, or 8 for jammy.
Move the eggs to an ice bath and let them rest at least 5 minutes.
Peel, halve and serve with salt or soy sauce.
tips: Boil for 8 minutes instead of 7 for a jammier yolk.
